scope: Four native source/finish comparisons, plus complete uncaptioned primary ST/SB phone strips; no generator/display/preference changes.

comparisons.inspection: Actual native source inspected in prior batch and actual complete F1 native inspected now, view_image detail original
observations: Armor microfacets and floor streaks are consolidated into broader intentional shapes. Dust remains grouped without the prior granular fringe.
Tavi face, two grips, continuous shaft, body poses and ring location remain.
Outlined warm cartoon drawing survives; this is not a glossy style replacement.
limitations_and_regressions: Marked-arm side and lower-shin contact issues persist; no structural correction claimed.
comparisons.verdict: Clear surface improvement without a newly obvious major structural regression.

comparisons.inspection: Actual native source inspected in prior batch and actual complete F1 native inspected now, view_image detail original
observations: Laughter, seated weight, hands, continuous hammer and visible worn orange face remain.
Armor and skin scuff speckles reduce substantially; broad material shading remains.
limitations_and_regressions: Ground still carries some mottled warm texture, though less fragmented than source.
Exact missing-chip shape was already inconsistent before finish; retained wear is not proof of exact cross-frame damage continuity.
comparisons.verdict: Useful surface refinement; character aftermath remains strong.

comparisons.inspection: Actual native source inspected in prior batch and actual complete F1 native inspected now, view_image detail original
observations: Near boot/armor/floor surfaces become much quieter, reducing dominant foreground noise.
Extreme scale, open gauntlet, Tavi grin/two grips, motion hook and head-to-leg contact persist.
limitations_and_regressions: Pale chip/scrape marks on the orange hammer face are removed. This is a visible persistent-damage regression.
Arm-side failure and hammer-head-versus-shaft contact remain; finish does not solve them.
comparisons.verdict: Strong surface gain with a small damage-state regression; not an unqualified success.

comparisons.inspection: Actual native source inspected in prior batch and actual complete F1 native inspected now, view_image detail original
observations: Wall/floor/cloth microtexture is consolidated into broad warm planes.
Faces, positions, one spear, shield, cape char and overall scorch placement remain.
limitations_and_regressions: Foreground scorch retains granular fragments and orange edge mottling; quieter surrounding planes help isolate it.
Partly hidden injured casting-forearm pose remains ambiguous; finish does not validate prior return mechanics.
comparisons.verdict: Clear surface improvement with localized residual scorch noise.

primary_phone.inspection: Actual complete uncaptioned 390px ST and SB strips
primary_phone.ST: Strike, dodge, low trip and shared breathing/laughter read as a sequence without captions. Delayed-mark rule is weakened by arm-side discontinuity. Later frames visibly accumulate texture.
primary_phone.SB: High defense, burned cape, lowered spear response and hurt caster read as a general sequence. The third-frame Y-branch does not establish a redirected return without explanation.
primary_phone.limit: These captures precede finish selection. Matching final-phone assessment remains pending; no claim of finish phone review.

taste_limit: Agent craft observations, not owner approval.
